column1: # Optional fallback. The preferred place for a provider pin is one `model_provider`
# line in the lane profile itself, which both the native Codex spawn path and
# scripts/cast-call.sh read, and which install-agents.sh accepts as a CUSTOMIZED state.
# This file exists for the case where you would rather not touch the installed profile;
# cast-call.sh reads it and passes `-c model_provider=<id>` per invocation. It has no
# The id must match a [model_providers.<id>] block in your Codex config.toml.
# Nothing is mapped by default. Uncomment and edit to match YOUR provider ids, or pass
# --provider <id> on the command line, which always wins over this file.
